scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && npm run sync-dist
scripts.sync-dist: mkdir -p ../../charts/spa-demo/files/runtime ../../charts/spa-demo/files/site/assets ../../charts/spa-demo/files/site/images && cp dist/server.js ../../charts/spa-demo/files/runtime/server.js && cp dist/index.html ../../charts/spa-demo/files/site/index.html && cp dist/assets/app.js ../../charts/spa-demo/files/site/assets/app.js && cp dist/images/*.svg ../../charts/spa-demo/files/site/images/
